name: lock-then-bar-2
about: Re-check: a lock kept when one bar is rewritten.

steps.say: make a 2 bar bassline on track 3
open the filter on just the first note, as a lock
now change only bar 2 so it ends higher
is the filter lock on the first note still there?

name: copy-to-t2-2
about: Re-check: a beat copied to another drum track, then varied.

steps.say: make a beat on track 1
copy the beat to track 2 and make that one busier

name: open-hat-right
about: Re-check: a drum key found by its plain name in the key planner.

steps.say: make a beat with an open hat
pan the open hat to the right

name: reverb-on-clap
about: Re-check: one sound of a kit sent to the reverb, with the sound skill loaded.

steps.say: make a house beat with a clap
put reverb on the clap only

name: play-this-3
about: Re-check: notes to play, written and started.

steps.say: play this on track 5: A4 C5 E5 A5 G5 E5 C5 D5, eighth notes

name: mutes-by-hand
about: Trouble: the user muted tracks by hand and lost the drums.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass
why did the drums and bass go silent?

name: build-up-beat
about: A beat that adds a sound every bar.

steps.say: make a 4 bar beat that adds one more drum sound every bar

name: boomy-bass
about: A sound problem: a boomy bass.

steps.say: make a beat with a bass
the bass is too boomy, fix it
make a trap beat with triplet hi-hat rolls

name: song-length
about: A question about the replica's own song.

steps.say: make a song with an intro, a verse and a chorus
how long is the song in seconds, and how many bars?
make a song with a verse and a chorus
make the chorus louder than the verse

name: swing-hats-only
about: A groove for one sound of a kit, which grooves per pattern.

steps.say: make a house beat
swing just the hats, keep the kick straight

name: arp-follows-chords
about: One track's arpeggio following another track's chords.

steps.say: put Cmaj7 Am7 Dm7 G7 on track 7, a chord a bar
make track 6 arpeggiate those chords

name: name-melody
about: A playful constraint: a melody from letters.

steps.say: write a melody using only the notes in the word CABBAGE

name: fade-one-bar-steps
about: Re-check: a fade in one-bar steps.

steps.say: make a 4 bar loop with drums and chords
make a song that plays it twice, then fades out bar by bar over one more pass

name: beginner-first
about: A beginner with no idea where to start.

steps.say: I just got my OP-XY and I have no idea what I'm doing. help
ok make something and show me how you did it
